A [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] '''prison camp''' was established on the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]] during the Federation's [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|occupation]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="Starfighter" />

==Description==

The camp was near the base of a [[Water/Legends|waterfall]], with [[Camp One|Camps One]], [[Camp Two|Two]], and [[Camp Three (Naboo)/Legends|Three]] on nearby islands in the Solleu River. Defenses included [[turret droid]]s, [[Trade Federation Patrol Boat|Patrol Boats]], and [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]]. A [[Dam/Legends|dam]] with a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] blocked downstream access.

==History==

The prison camp was established by the Trade Federation in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> to house [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] prisoners during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].<ref name="Starfighter" />

Soon after, [[Rescue Flight]] and [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] joined forces to [[Raid on the Solleu River|liberate civilians]] from the camp. Bravo Flight’s [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] destroyed the camp’s turret droids and the dam’s deflector shield, allowing all prisoners to be evacuated from the islands by [[Rescue Boat|boat]].<ref name="Starfighter" />

==Behind the scenes==
The prison camp appears in the twelfth mission of the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']].
